editorial:
Imagine you are relaxing at home with your headphones on, listening to your favorite true crime podcast, only to realize the narrator is describing exactly what is happening in your house in real time. That is the scary setup here. You follow a young woman who thinks she is just a fan of a show, but she quickly becomes the target of a masked killer who uses the podcast to taunt her. The whole movie feels like a bright, neon-colored dream that slowly turns into a nightmare. It has a very cool style with lots of bold colors and a creepy mood that keeps you on edge from the start.

The acting is great and the twists actually surprise you instead of being obvious. While some of the slow parts might feel a bit long, the final act is a wild ride that makes up for it. If you love slashers with a modern twist, you need to see this.
endingExplained: You find out the podcast host is actually the killer. He used the show to scout his victims and play mind games with them. In the final fight, the main character manages to trick him by using his own recording equipment against him. She knocks him out and calls the police just as the final episode ends. It turns out she was the only person smart enough to outwit him, leaving her as the sole survivor.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime podcasts and scary masked killers.
